subtitle: Out Manila · Fly + cruise
overview: Fly China Southern via Guangzhou to Yichang, spend one night in a 5★ hotel, then board the Vista Aurora for four nights on the Yangtze River through the Three Gorges. You finish in Chongqing with a 5★ hotel night and sights such as Liziba light rail, Hongyadong and Ciqikou Ancient Town. The package has no shopping stops, and an English-speaking guide travels with you.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 26–Dec 2 2026 to Dec 10–16 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Sanyou Cave: A scenic cave and gorge site near Yichang, visited before boarding the cruise.
placeDesc.Gezhou Dam: A large dam on the Yangtze at Yichang, visited on a complimentary tour.
placeDesc.Xiling Gorge: The easternmost of the Three Gorges, with the eastern section seen on a complimentary tour.
placeDesc.Vista Aurora Cruise: The Yangtze River cruise ship that is your floating hotel for four nights.
placeDesc.Three Gorges Dam: The huge dam on the Yangtze at Sandouping, visited on a shore excursion.
placeDesc.Three Gorges Ship Lift: The vertical ship lift beside the dam, seen from the cruise.
placeDesc.Badong Yuxian Valley: A scenic valley visited from the cruise on April to October departures.
placeDesc.Wushan Goddess Stream: A scenic gorge stream near Wushan, visited from the cruise on November to March departures.
placeDesc.Baidi City: A hilltop temple town at the head of Qutang Gorge, linked with Three Kingdoms history.
placeDesc.Baiheliang Underwater Museum: A museum in Fuling built to protect an ancient stone ridge that served as a river-level marker.
placeDesc.Fuling Pickled Mustard Tuber Museum: A museum about Fuling's famous pickled mustard tuber, a Chongqing-area specialty.
placeDesc.Project 816 Site: A former secret military project site in Fuling, now opened to visitors.
placeDesc.Fengdu Ghost City: A mountain temple complex at Fengdu, known for folklore about the underworld.
placeDesc.Liziba Station: A Chongqing metro station where the light rail passes through a residential building.
placeDesc.Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street: The central pedestrian shopping district of Chongqing around the Jiefangbei monument.
placeDesc.Hongyadong: A Chongqing riverside complex of stilted buildings on a cliff, lit up at night.
placeDesc.Ciqikou Ancient Town: A restored riverside old town in Chongqing with stone alleys, teahouses and snack shops.
